title: Finite-open transfer with prime module coefficients
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $f\circ p:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ separated finite-type curves of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], with $p:Y\to X$ finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Let $j:U\to X$ and $a:V\to Y$ be open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion], and $v:V\to U$ make $(a,v,p,j)$ cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let $r$ be prime, $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Z/r\mathbf Z)$, $F,H$ sheaves of $R$-modules on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$, and $e:F\simeq H$. If all eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold for $a_!F$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] on $Y$, they hold for $j_!v_*H$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] on $X$. This is independent of any filtration or constant-case hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply a_! to e and transfer assertions along the resulting sheaf isomorphism. All sheaves are r-torsion. Apply the finite-pushforward curve assertions to the underlying abelian sheaf, comparing its integral coefficient realization with the prime module realization. Cohomology and primary/invertible torsion depend only on the underlying abelian sheaf. For C4/C5 use constructibility descent from finite pushforward when the conditional hypotheses hold; equivalence of the integral and prime module notions over a finite coefficient ring supplies the coefficient bridge.
Finite-open exchange gives j_! v_* H isomorphic to p_* a_! H. Naturality transports the cohomology and comparison maps, hence all eight assertions, across this isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem prime_module_finite_open_assertions_transfer
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X U V Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] (p : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite p]
    [IsCurve (p ≫ f)] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (a : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion a] (v : V ⟶ U) (sq : IsPullback a v p j)
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (F H : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    (e : F ≅ H)
    (hF : Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) (p ≫ f)
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) a).obj
        F)) :
    Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) f
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) j).obj
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj H))
